tailoring.headline: Fullstack E-Commerce Engineer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, JavaScript | 5+ years
tailoring.summary: Backend and frontend engineer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and JavaScript storefront customization. Proven ability to design and implement PIM-ERP integrations, optimize SQL performance, and run CI/CD pipelines in Docker/Kubernetes. Strong techno-functional consultant: gather requirements, write user stories, and support production. Agile team player skilled in code reviews, automated testing and cross-functional collaboration.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Fullstack Software Engineer (f/m/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Koro’s mission to deliver a seamless shopping experience through a modern e-commerce storefront. With over five years of building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in end-to-end feature delivery, integration and performance optimisation.

bullets.label: Fullstack Delivery
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented both backend services and storefront customizations on SAP Commerce Cloud, delivering end-to-end features that mirror Koro’s fullstack responsibilities.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: I built OCC REST APIs and PIM-ERP data pipelines, ensuring reliable system integrations—directly aligning with Koro’s need for robust REST API development and integration.

bullets.label: Performance & Reliability
bullets.text: Through SQL query optimisation and CI/CD pipelines on Docker/Kubernetes, I improved response times and system stability, supporting Koro’s focus on performance and reliability.

bullets.label: Collaboration & Agile
bullets.text: My techno-functional role involved gathering requirements, writing user stories and collaborating with international product and QA teams, matching Koro’s cross-functional collaboration and agile delivery model.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit and am serving notice until 15 December 2026, with earliest start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Koro.

tailoring.why_company: KoRo’s commitment to flexible, hybrid work and its rapid growth in the online grocery market resonate with my passion for building high-performing e-commerce platforms that serve millions of customers. The emphasis on end-to-end feature ownership and continuous improvement aligns perfectly with my experience delivering full-stack SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, integrating product data, and enhancing performance. I am eager to bring my technical depth and collaborative mindset to help KoRo scale its storefront further.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join KoRo to apply my full-stack e-commerce expertise in a fast-growing, flexible environment, delivering high-quality storefront features that delight customers.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering full-stack e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about KoRo’s innovative storefront and would love to discuss how I can contribute.
tailoring.offer: In my first months I will accelerate new feature rollout by leveraging my experience building OCC REST APIs and PIM-ERP integrations on SAP Commerce Cloud. I will also boost performance and reliability through proven SQL optimisation and CI/CD pipelines in Docker/Kubernetes.
tailoring.insight: The posting highlights end-to-end feature delivery across the storefront; my track record of delivering complete SAP Commerce Cloud features from design to production will help KoRo ship high-quality updates faster.
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, I am Kranti Chavan, a senior e-commerce engineer with 5+ years delivering full-stack SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am drawn to KoRo’s focus on seamless shopping experiences and flexible work culture. I can immediately contribute by building robust REST APIs, integrating product data, and improving performance through CI/CD and SQL optimisation. I also noticed your emphasis on end-to-end feature ownership, which matches my proven delivery record. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
